claim: IEA states that global electricity demand is expected to grow rapidly in 2025 and 2026, supported by industry, appliances, air conditioning, data centres, EVs, and other electrification drivers.
source_title: Global electricity demand to keep growing robustly through 2026 despite economic headwinds

claim: IEA Electricity 2026 frames the period as an 'Age of Electricity' with growing consumption from AI, data centres, electrification of industry, transport, and buildings, and includes focused analysis on grids and flexibility.
IEA Electricity 2026 says renewables, natural gas, and nuclear together are expected to meet all additional global electricity demand in aggregate over 2026-2030.

NERC's 2025 Long-Term Reliability Assessment highlights intensifying resource-adequacy risks over the next decade and notes that data-center projects have moved from speculative/exploratory stages into development commitments that affect load forecasting.
DOE's Office of Electricity states that distribution transformers are building blocks of the electric grid and are facing supply-chain constraints, long lead times, and component shortages.

DOE reports that COVID-era supply and labor constraints plus material shortages drove distribution-transformer lead times from three to six months in 2019 to 12 to 30 months in 2023, the latest available data cited on the DOE page.

FERC directed PJM to establish transparent rules to facilitate service for AI-driven data centers and other large loads co-located with generating facilities, while addressing reliability and capacity-addition concerns.
source_title: FERC Directs Nation’s Largest Grid Operator to Create New Rules to Embrace Innovation and Protect Consumers

claim: IEA's Gas Market Report Q1 2026 states that global LNG supply growth is set to accelerate in 2026, supporting stronger natural-gas demand and a new all-time high.

EIA's AEO2026 analysis projects U.S. dry natural gas production to increase significantly over coming decades, meeting growing domestic and international demand, and includes a case exploring higher power demand from data centers.
source_title: Domestic and international demand drive natural gas production growth

claim: DOE announced that Centrus produced about 900 kilograms of HALEU by June 2025, describing HALEU as a crucial fuel source needed by most advanced reactor designs.
source_title: Centrus Reaches 900 Kilogram Mark for HALEU Production

claim: World Nuclear Association states that HALEU will be needed for many advanced power reactor fuels and more than half of SMR designs in development.
IEA's Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2025 notes that expanding construction and electrification of grids and industrial equipment are fueling increased copper demand.
source_title: Overview of outlook for key minerals - Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2025

claim: Digital Realty's March 2026 investor presentation says AI affects customer engagement, data-center design, and product offerings, and says PlatformDIGITAL is positioned to benefit from AI training and inference.

Equinix disclosed 52 active major development projects as of January 2026 across 35 metros, expected to deliver more than 55,000 cabinets of retail capacity and more than 100 MW of xScale capacity through 2028.
Dominion's annual-report filing says much of its growth is being driven by the data-center industry and that it has been connecting an average of 15 data centers per year.
source_title: Dominion Energy 2025 Annual Report and Proxy Filing

claim: Data Center Dynamics reported that Dominion described more than 48 GW of data-center-related pipeline in various stages of contracting as of December 2025 and a higher five-year capital plan tied largely to Virginia demand.
source_title: Dominion reports marginal increase in data center pipeline

claim: Vistra describes itself as a leading integrated retail electricity and power-generation company; its 2026 CERAWeek materials discuss rapidly growing energy demand, data-center demand, reliability, and nuclear power's role.
source_title: CERAWeek 2026: Powering What’s Next - Vistra Corp.

claim: IES states that it designs and installs integrated electrical and technology systems and provides infrastructure products and services to end markets including data centers.
IES fiscal 2026 first-quarter materials state that results reflected continued solid demand and execution in the data-center end market.
source_title: IES Holdings Reports Fiscal 2026 First Quarter Results

claim: EIA forecast U.S. retail electricity sales growth of 2.2% annually in both 2025 and 2026, with ERCOT demand expected to grow 7% in 2025 and 14% in 2026, and PJM sales expected to grow 3% in 2025 and 4% in 2026.
source_title: We expect rapid electricity demand growth in Texas and the mid-Atlantic

claim: EIA's high-demand scenario assumes faster data-center-driven load growth, with natural gas as the primary incremental source of available power generation and a modeled 79% higher 2027 ERCOT wholesale price versus the February 2026 STEO baseline.
source_title: Fossil generation could rise with faster-than-expected growth in data center power demand

claim: NERC's 2025 Long-Term Reliability Assessment states that new AI and digital-economy data centers account for most of the projected increase in North American electricity demand over the next 10 years, with Texas, PJM, and WECC reporting steep increases from data centers and large loads.

Wood Mackenzie, as reported by pv magazine USA, estimated a 2025 U.S. supply deficit of 30% for power transformers and 10% for distribution transformers, with imports expected to account for 80% of U.S. power transformer supply and 50% of distribution transformer supply.
source_title: Grid transformers face significant supply deficits, says Wood Mackenzie

claim: FERC launched a review of co-location issues involving AI-enabled data centers and generating facilities in PJM, focusing on tariff clarity, reliability, and fair consumer cost allocation.
source_title: FERC Orders Action on Co-Location Issues Related to Data Centers Running AI

claim: PJM filed proposals in February 2026 to extend a capacity-auction price collar and create an expedited interconnection track for qualifying new generation as part of a large-load plan driven largely by data-center growth.
source_title: PJM Files Price Collar, Expedited Interconnection as Part of Large Load Plan

claim: PJM's 2025 annual report states that the 2027/2028 Base Residual Auction fell short of PJM's Reliability Requirement by 6,517 MW, the first such shortfall since the auction was created in 2007, as forecasted demand growth outpaced new generation resources.

GE Vernova reported that Gas Power equipment backlog and slot reservation agreements grew from 83 GW to 100 GW in Q1 2026, and that its Electrification segment booked $2.4 billion of data-center-supporting equipment orders in the quarter.
source_title: GE Vernova reports first quarter 2026 financial results and raises 2026 guidance

claim: EIA forecast natural gas consumption for power generation to reach a summer record in 2027, citing new data centers and large manufacturing facilities, particularly in Texas and Virginia, as drivers of commercial demand.
source_title: Natural gas for power generation flat this summer, record high expected in 2027

claim: Because transformers, switchgear, substations, gas turbines, EPC labor, and interconnection approvals are all sequential dependencies, small hardware or permitting delays can block much larger data-center and generation capex from becoming operating load or operating supply.
source_title: Fossil generation could rise with faster-than-expected growth in data center power demand

claim: Powell Industries reported approximately $1.4 billion of backlog as of September 30, 2025, and disclosed the acquisition of Remsdaq, a U.K.-based manufacturer of SCADA remote terminal units for electrical substation control and automation.
Powell Industries reported backlog of $1.4 billion as of June 30, 2025, up 7% sequentially and 5% year over year.
source_title: Powell Industries Announces Third Quarter Fiscal 2025 Results

claim: Hubbell describes itself as a manufacturer of electrical products and utility solutions for a broad range of customer and end-market applications.
Hubbell's 2025 annual report shows Utility Solutions net sales of $3.672 billion and Electrical Solutions net sales of $2.172 billion, with Utility Solutions the larger segment.
source_title: Hubbell Incorporated 2025 Annual Report and Notice of Annual Meeting

claim: Hubbell disclosed the 2025 acquisition of DMC Power, described as serving utility substation markets.
source_title: Hubbell Incorporated 2025 Annual Report and Notice of Annual Meeting to Shareholders

claim: Comfort Systems USA stated that demand increases have been especially strong in the technology sector, particularly data centers, and reported year-end 2025 backlog of $11.94 billion.
Comfort Systems USA reported backlog of $8.12 billion as of June 30, 2025, compared with $5.77 billion as of June 30, 2024.
source_title: Comfort Systems USA Reports Second Quarter 2025 Results

claim: Sterling Infrastructure reported that 2025 revenue growth was driven in part by a $543.0 million increase in E-Infrastructure Solutions, higher data-center volume, and revenue contribution from an electrical and mechanical business acquired late in Q3 2025.

Sterling Infrastructure's 2025 annual report cites significant growth opportunities tied to multi-year capital deployment plans by data-center customers and reported backlog of $3.01 billion at December 31, 2025, versus $1.69 billion at December 31, 2024.

EMCOR reported 2025 U.S. electrical construction and facilities services revenue of $5.07 billion, up from $3.34 billion in 2024, with network and communications growth driven by data-center construction projects.
EMCOR's annual report describes electrical and mechanical construction services for large installation projects, including data centers, high-tech manufacturing, and infrastructure projects.
IES Holdings designs and installs integrated electrical and technology systems for end markets including data centers, and reported record Communications backlog at September 30, 2025.
IES Holdings reported that fiscal 2025 and 2024 segment results benefited from favorable project execution and scope additions at favorable margins on large data-center projects.
source_title: IES Holdings Reports Fiscal 2025 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results

claim: EIA reported that PJM expects the Dominion zone, covering Virginia, to have the largest absolute increase in summer peak demand from 2026 through 2030, largely due to data-center load growth.
source_title: Commercial electricity sales have soared in Virginia, driven by data centers

claim: Dominion Energy's 2025 annual report states that much of its growth is being driven by the booming data-center industry.
Dominion Energy's 2025 Form 10-K references data centers as a source of significant increase in annual load growth over the next ten years for the PJM DOM Zone.
nVent markets data-center and networking solutions including cooling technology, intelligent power distribution units, cabinets, racks, and enclosures.

nVent's relationship to the theme is likely component-level rather than primary bottleneck control unless filings show material data-center or power-utility exposure and constrained supply for its connection/protection products.
Vistra's 2025 annual report states that it is one of the largest U.S. producers of power in deregulated markets, with expected annual generation of more than 230 TWh as of December 31, 2025.
Vistra's 2025 annual report disclosed January 2026 agreements with Meta for 20-year PPAs covering 2,609 MW of carbon-free power and capacity from PJM nuclear power assets.
Vistra reported plans to repower the Coleto Creek and Miami Fort coal generation facilities as natural-gas-fueled generation.
Equinix reported robust 2024 xScale demand and leasing activity driven by service providers supporting AI and cloud initiatives.
source_title: Equinix Reports Strong Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2024 Results

claim: Equinix disclosed a renewable energy PPA in Japan securing 30 MW of renewable electricity capacity scheduled to commence in 2028.
Equinix's 2025 sustainability reporting disclosed 96% renewable energy coverage across retail IBX data centers and a 5.3% PUE improvement.
Digital Realty stated in May 2026 that it is responding to increasing data-center demand from AI and the digital economy, and disclosed 1.7 GW of large-scale renewable energy capacity contracted.
Digital Realty disclosed a roughly 100-acre Atlanta metro land acquisition expected to support more than 200 MW of IT capacity.
source_title: Digital Realty Reports Second Quarter 2025 Results

claim: Cummins describes its power generation offering as standby and prime power generators from 2 kW to 3.5 MW, plus controls, paralleling systems, and transfer switches for customers including data centers.
Cummins' 2025 Form 10-K states that increases were mainly due to strong growth in power-generation markets, especially data-center and commercial markets.
Cummins stated that 2026 expectations include continued strength in data-center power-generation markets.
source_title: Cummins Reports Strong Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Results

claim: Eaton's 2025 annual report disclosed Electrical segment customer-demand metrics including backlog of $13.246 billion versus $10.141 billion, 31% backlog growth, 19% organic backlog growth, 16% organic customer order growth, book-to-bill of 1.2, and strength in data-center end markets.
Quanta Services reported full-year 2025 results with year-end RPO of $23.76 billion, total backlog of $43.98 billion, and all-time highs in Electric Infrastructure Solutions segment RPO and backlog.
source_title: Quanta Services Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Results

claim: Quanta's 2025 10-K states that its Electric segment provides services for electric power, power generation, large load center, and communications markets.

GE Vernova's 2025 annual report page states 2025 orders of $59 billion, revenue of $38 billion, adjusted EBITDA of $3.2 billion, free cash flow of $3.7 billion, and an $86 billion services backlog; it also describes investment in high-voltage switchgear products and data-center-related solid-state transformer work.
source_title: GE Vernova 2025 Annual Report CEO Letter

claim: GE Vernova's Q4/full-year 2025 results release stated that Gas Power equipment backlog and slot reservation agreements grew from 62 GW to 83 GW and that orders increased 21% organically with strong demand for grid equipment.
source_title: GE Vernova Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

claim: Constellation announced a 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft to support launch of the Crane Clean Energy Center and restart of Three Mile Island Unit 1, with Microsoft purchasing energy to help match PJM data-center power use with carbon-free energy.
source_title: Constellation to Launch Crane Clean Energy Center, Restoring Jobs and Carbon-free Power to the Grid

claim: The U.S. Department of Energy stated that Centrus produced nearly one metric ton of HALEU and described HALEU as a crucial fuel source required by most advanced reactor designs.
source_title: Centrus Reaches 900 Kilogram Mark for HALEU Production

claim: Centrus disclosed that DOE amended the HALEU Operation Contract on June 17, 2025, dividing the first three-year option period, and that expansion depends on future DOE task orders.

Cameco's 2025 annual report disclosed 21.0 million pounds of uranium production, 14.0 million kgU of fuel services production including a record 11.2 million kgU of UF6 at Port Hope, about 230 million pounds of long-term uranium delivery commitments, and about 83 million kgU of contracted UF6 conversion volumes.

BWX Technologies' 2025 10-K summary describes Government operations focused on naval nuclear components, reactors, fuel, and U.S. nuclear site management, while Commercial supplies heavy nuclear components, fuel, services, and medical radioisotopes; it also reports Advanced Reactor Design and Engineering revenue.

PG&E's 2025 sustainability reporting states it is working to serve approximately 10 GW of new data-center energy demand over the next decade, with 1.4 GW currently in final design and projected to come online between 2026 and 2030.

Southern Company's 2025 Year in Review says electric sales are projected to grow by 8% annually through 2029, driven by data centers, advanced manufacturing, and residential expansion across its footprint.

NextEra Energy's Q1 2025 financial release said Energy Resources added approximately 3.2 GW of new renewables and storage origination to backlog, bringing backlog to roughly 28 GW after 0.7 GW of projects placed in service.
source_title: NextEra Energy Reports First Quarter 2025 Financial Results

claim: AES's 2025 annual report states that its Renewables SBU is well-positioned to benefit from data-center growth and identifies its Renewables business as solar, wind, energy storage, and hydro generation.

Williams disclosed Q1 2026 data-center-related projects including Atlas, an agreement to provide up to 164 MMcf/d of pipeline capacity for a large Northeast data-center customer by year-end 2026, and NEO, a 682 MW behind-the-meter power project targeted for service in the second half of 2028.
source_title: Q1 Earnings Recap: Data centers accelerate new growth paths for Williams

claim: Williams stated at its 2026 Analyst Day that LNG exports and power generation are primary long-term demand drivers and that data centers are expected to account for a large share of U.S. gas-fired electricity demand growth through 2035.
source_title: Natural gas infrastructure is the fix for surging energy demand

claim: Energy Transfer's January 2026 investor presentation stated that most 2026 growth capex would enhance its natural-gas pipeline network, and listed more than 105,000 miles of gas gathering/interstate/intrastate pipelines, more than 55 Bcf/d of pipeline throughput capacity, and about 236 Bcf of natural-gas storage capacity.

Energy Transfer's Q1 2026 materials disclosed demand-pull contracts from end users, data centers, and utilities totaling more than 6 Bcf/d of contracted pipeline capacity, with an 18-year weighted average life and more than $25 billion of expected firm-transportation-fee revenue.

Energy Transfer's Q1 2026 call discussed new pipelines and meter stations to provide natural gas to power plants and data-center sites in Oklahoma and Arkansas, and firm gas transportation for the Nexus Hubbard behind-the-meter AI hyperscale campus in Central Texas.
source_title: Energy Transfer Q1 2026 Earnings Call: Complete Transcript

claim: Kinder Morgan's 2Q 2026 investor presentation framed the company as positioned to meet surging data-center power demand and used 1 GW equals 0.15 Bcf/d of natural gas as a conversion assumption for potential data-center gas capacity needs.

RBN Energy summarized Kinder Morgan Q1 2026 commentary as emphasizing that U.S. gas infrastructure buildout is no longer only an LNG story, with rising gas-fired power demand tied partly to data centers and the Creekside Lateral targeted for 4Q 2026 to serve power, industrial, and data-center demand.

Cheniere's 2025 earnings materials pointed to a high-growth period for global LNG supply and demand from 2026 to 2030, supporting the company's linkage to global LNG demand rather than a narrow U.S. data-center power node.
First Solar reported Q1 2026 net sales of $1.04 billion, up 24% year over year, and contracted sales backlog of 47.9 GW as of March 31, 2026.
source_title: First Solar Q1 2026 Results Press Release

claim: First Solar's Q1 2026 earnings presentation listed a 47.9 GW and $14.4 billion contracted backlog.
Enphase reported Q1 2026 revenue of $282.9 million versus $343.3 million in Q4 2025; U.S. revenue declined about 23% sequentially due to Section 25D tax-credit expiration and seasonality.
source_title: Enphase Energy Reports Financial Results for the First Quarter of 2026

claim: Fluence Energy reported Q2 FY2026 backlog of about $5.6 billion as of March 31, 2026, a record level for the company, and reaffirmed FY2026 guidance.
source_title: Fluence Energy, Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results; Reaffirms Fiscal Year 2026 Guidance

claim: Freeport-McMoRan's 2025 annual report framed copper as core to its strategy and tied copper demand to secular trends in electrification and technological development.
Southern Copper's 1Q26 company presentation framed copper as a critical mineral for the energy transition, citing rising demand and potentially constrained supply growth.
source_title: Southern Copper Company Presentation - 1Q26 Production and Capex Guidance

claim: MP Materials announced a public-private partnership with the U.S. Department of Defense to accelerate an end-to-end U.S. rare earth magnet supply chain, with planned total U.S. rare earth magnet manufacturing capacity estimated at 10,000 metric tons after the new facility is completed.
source_title: MP Materials Announces Transformational Public-Private Partnership with the Department of Defense
